# Santa Barbara Chocolate
> Santa Barbara Chocolate supplies vegan chocolates, cocoa powders, and high-flavanol cacao. The company focuses on ethically sourced, clean-label ingredients for chefs, bakers, and chocolate lovers worldwide.


## Company Information
- Founded: 1992  
- Industry: Wholesale High Flavanol Cacao & Cocoa Powder Products
- Headquarters: Ventura, California, USA  
- Address: 2112 Eastman Ave. Ste. 113, Ventura, CA 93003, USA  
- Phone: (805) 477-7682  
- Email: info@santabarbarachocolate.com  
- Website: [Santa Barbara Chocolate](https://www.santabarbarachocolate.com/)  


## Specialties
- Vegan chocolates, dark cocoa powder, pure cacao, and high-flavanol products in bulk  
- Serving chefs, chocolatiers, bakers, and chocolate enthusiasts worldwide  


## Certifications & Sourcing
- Partners accredited with HACCP, UTZ, USDA Organic, NOP Organic, Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance  
- Ethical sourcing, frequent safety testing, low heavy metals, and clean-label ingredients  
- [About Us](https://www.santabarbarachocolate.com/about-us/)


## Categories
- [Vegan Chocolates](https://www.santabarbarachocolate.com/vegan-chocolates/): Plant-based chocolates made with pure ingredients, ideal for vegan diets and clean-label recipes
- [Dark Cocoa Powder](https://www.santabarbarachocolate.com/cocoa-powder/): Rich and aromatic cocoa powders perfect for baking, desserts, and gourmet creations
- [High Flavanol Cacao](https://www.santabarbarachocolate.com/high-flavanol-cacao/): Cocoa powder with high flavanol content, offering strong antioxidant benefits and a pure chocolate taste

## Ingredients
- Key ingredients include organic cacao beans, cane sugar, cocoa butter, and sunflower lecithin (non-GMO)
- Example: High-flavanol cocoa, dark cocoa powder, 72% dark chocolate with polyphenols

## Summary
>Santa Barbara Chocolate is a California-based wholesale cocoa powder and high flavanol cacao supplier founded in 1992. Headquartered in Ventura, the company specializes in ethically sourced, clean-label chocolate ingredients designed for both professionals and home chocolate enthusiasts. Their product line includes vegan chocolates, organic cocoa powders, pure cacao, cacao nibs, and high-flavanol cocoa products valued for their antioxidant content.
>The business places a strong focus on sustainability and quality. They work with partners certified by HACCP, USDA Organic, NOP Organic, Fair Trade, UTZ, and Rainforest Alliance to ensure responsible sourcing and food safety standards. Every product is tested frequently for quality and purity, with an emphasis on low heavy metals and transparent labeling.
>Santa Barbara Chocolate serves a wide range of customers, from chefs, bakers, and chocolatiers to individuals looking for gourmet and healthier chocolate options. Their packaging and shipping practices are designed to maintain freshness and product integrity, using insulated boxes and ice packs during warm weather to prevent melting. U.S. customers benefit from free shipping on orders over $75.
>In addition to products, the company maintains educational resources including a recipe blog, FAQs, and chocolate-related videos, helping customers learn more about cacao, baking, and sourcing. Their affiliate program allows partners to earn commissions by promoting the company’s ethically sourced chocolate.
>Santa Barbara Chocolate continues to stand out for combining traditional chocolate craftsmanship with modern values of ethical trade, sustainability, and transparency.
